evals.name: entry-written-and-report-committed
evals.prompt: Build the fixture with evals/inputs/build_fixture.sh in an empty temporary directory, scenario `entry`; it prints the instance root, project and change key. You are in a content-editor session. Run changelog-line for that project and key.

assertions.name: skill-invoked-by-its-name
assertions.description: The run invokes the skill named changelog-line (not development-content), and its final message begins with the word changelog-line.

assertions.name: entry-under-unreleased
assertions.description: The change worktree's products/widget/CHANGELOG.md holds a new list item under `## [Unreleased]`, inside a `### Added` group, that begins `- **demo** — ` and ends with a parenthesis holding at least one inline-code SHA of 9 or more hex digits.

assertions.name: cited-commit-on-branch
assertions.description: Every SHA the entry cites resolves with `git cat-file -t` in the change worktree and is reachable from the change's branch.

assertions.name: report-committed-with-four-sections
assertions.description: `git -C <instance worktree> ls-tree -r <key> --name-only` lists system/projects/demo/journey/tobiishi/<key>/changelog-report.md, and that file has the headings Change, Changelog, What-left and Evidence.

assertions.name: older-history-unchanged
assertions.description: The `## [1.0.0] - 2025-12-01` section and its entry are byte-identical to the base commit's.

assertions.name: final-message-reports-commit-and-report
assertions.description: The final message holds a sentence starting `changelog-line made commit` with a SHA of 9+ hex digits, and a sentence starting `The run's report is`, and `The run added an entry under`.

assertions.name: report-carries-no-frontmatter
assertions.description: In the instance repository, `git show <key>:system/projects/demo/journey/tobiishi/<key>/changelog-report.md` prints `# Changelog report — <key>` as its first line, not `---`, and no line of the file starts with `version:`. A report that opens with the template's frontmatter fails, whatever version it names.

evals.name: wrong-posture-refuses-first
evals.prompt: Build the fixture with evals/inputs/build_fixture.sh in an empty temporary directory, scenario `entry`; it prints the instance root, project and change key. You are in a developer session, not a content-editor one. Run changelog-line for that project and key.

assertions.name: positive-refusal
assertions.description: The final message states `changelog-line changed no file and made no commit.` and that it needs Content Editor posture, naming `content-editor` as the posture to open.

assertions.name: no-project-input-read
assertions.description: The run's transcript shows no read of any file under the fixture's system/projects or products before the refusal (the fixture may be built, but not read).

assertions.name: nothing-written
assertions.description: `git status --porcelain` in the instance worktree is empty and `git log main..<key>` holds only the fixture's own commits; no changelog-report.md exists in the change folder.

evals.name: upgrading-group-for-a-required-clone-action
evals.prompt: Build the fixture with evals/inputs/build_fixture.sh in an empty temporary directory, scenario `upgrading`; it prints the instance root, project and change key. You are in a content-editor session. Run changelog-line for that project and key.

assertions.name: entry-in-upgrading
assertions.description: The new entry sits under a `### Upgrading` group in products/widget/CHANGELOG.md, and `### Upgrading` precedes every other group under `## [Unreleased]`.

assertions.name: entry-says-what-to-do
assertions.description: The entry names the variable WIDGET_GREETING and tells the reader to set or export it.
assertions.nuanced_justification: Whether the sentence tells a clone what to do is a reading of the sentence; a pattern for the variable name passes an entry that only mentions it. Structural tried: presence of WIDGET_GREETING, kept as the first half.

assertions.name: no-empty-groups
assertions.description: Under `## [Unreleased]` no `### ` heading is followed directly by another heading or by the next `## ` heading.

evals.name: test-only-change-earns-no-entry-but-completes
evals.prompt: Build the fixture with evals/inputs/build_fixture.sh in an empty temporary directory, scenario `tests-only`; it prints the instance root, project and change key. You are in a content-editor session. Run changelog-line for that project and key.

assertions.name: changelog-unchanged
assertions.description: products/widget/CHANGELOG.md in the change worktree is byte-identical to the base commit's.

assertions.name: final-message-says-no-entry
assertions.description: The final message holds `The change earns no entry in` and names products/widget.

assertions.name: report-still-committed
assertions.description: changelog-report.md is committed on the change's branch in the change folder, and its Changelog section says no entry is earned.

assertions.name: step-completes-not-refuses
assertions.description: The final message does not begin with `changelog-line changed no file and made no commit.`; it begins `changelog-line made commit`.

assertions.name: report-carries-no-frontmatter
assertions.description: In the instance repository, `git show <key>:system/projects/demo/journey/tobiishi/<key>/changelog-report.md` prints `# Changelog report — <key>` as its first line, not `---`, and no line of the file starts with `version:`. A report that opens with the template's frontmatter fails, whatever version it names.

assertions.name: merged-in-line

assertions.name: final-message-both-facts

assertions.name: h1-and-lead-unchanged

assertions.name: only-the-report-is-committed
assertions.description: `git diff --name-only main <key>` in the instance repository lists only paths under system/projects/demo/journey/tobiishi/<key>/ plus the change's own product commit, and no path under products/widget/CHANGELOG.md or docs/what_left.md.

assertions.name: final-message-says-why
assertions.description: The final message holds `keeps no `CHANGELOG.md`, so changelog-line wrote no entry and changed no product file.` and the run still committed changelog-report.md.

A report that opens with the template's frontmatter fails, whatever version it names.

evals.name: unreleased-heading-missing-or-doubled-halts
evals.prompt: Build the fixture with evals/inputs/build_fixture.sh in an empty temporary directory, scenario `unreleased-none`; it prints the instance root, project and change key. Then, in a second empty directory, build scenario `unreleased-two`. You are in a content-editor session. Run changelog-line for each fixture in turn.

assertions.name: both-refuse-with-count
assertions.description: For the first the final message holds `has no line that reads `## [Unreleased]``; for the second it holds `has 2 lines that read `## [Unreleased]``; both hold `needs exactly one, so it wrote neither the changelog nor the what-left file.`

assertions.name: both-targets-unchanged
assertions.description: In both fixtures products/widget/CHANGELOG.md and docs/what_left.md are byte-identical to the base commit's.

assertions.name: halt-report-no-success-report
assertions.description: Each change folder holds halt_report.md and no changelog-report.md, and each final message ends with `The halt report is`.

evals.name: removes-only-wholly-built-wants
evals.prompt: Build the fixture with evals/inputs/build_fixture.sh in an empty temporary directory, scenario `removals`; it prints the instance root, project and change key. You are in a content-editor session. Run changelog-line for that project and key.

assertions.name: two-removed-one-kept
assertions.description: docs/what_left.md no longer holds the `--json` want or the `widget history` want, and still holds the `$WIDGET_NAME` and `--name` want, byte-for-byte as its three lines were.

assertions.name: partial-want-kept-despite-visible-code
assertions.description: The `--name` want stays although the branch commit that reads WIDGET_NAME is on the branch.

assertions.name: body-lines-verbatim-with-metacharacters
assertions.description: The removing commit's body holds one `Merged in <sha>: ` line per removed entry, each carrying the Wanted text verbatim, backticks included, and none holding a `$` that was expanded.

assertions.name: final-message-says-two
assertions.description: The final message holds `The run removed 2 entries from`.

assertions.name: empty-marker-line

assertions.name: final-message-last-entry

assertions.name: already-empty-unchanged

evals.name: refused-commits-never-claim-success
evals.prompt: Build the fixture with evals/inputs/build_fixture.sh in an empty temporary directory, scenario `hook-refuses`; it prints the instance root, project and change key. Then build `external-report-refused` in another empty directory. You are in a content-editor session. Run changelog-line for each in turn.

assertions.name: first-commit-refused-message
assertions.description: For `hook-refuses` the final message holds `wrote its changes and made no commit, because the commit builder refused it.`, `The builder said this:` and the hook's text `fixture hook refuses`; the changed targets are left uncommitted and no commit was retried in another shape.

assertions.name: report-refused-message
assertions.description: For `external-report-refused` the final message holds `did not finish, because the commit builder refused the commit of its report.` and names the landed product commit and the uncommitted report path.

assertions.description: In both, `git ls-tree -r <key> --name-only` in the instance repository lists no changelog-report.md.

assertions.name: dirty-target-refuses
